sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "fees"."orderslink" AS e, "orders"."orderbase" AS g, SUM("fees"."rebtotal") AS m1 FROM "fees" JOIN "orders" ON "orders"."recordvault" = "fees"."orderslink"  GROUP BY "fees"."orderslink", "orders"."orderbase"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of total rebate per orders within orders.orderbase (additive)
share of the g total of total of total rebate (g level)
rank within the group by total of total rebate: share of the g total, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "orderexecutions"."ordersmark" AS e, "orders"."dealedge" AS g, AVG("orderexecutions"."fillcount") AS m1 FROM "orderexecutions" JOIN "orders" ON "orders"."recordvault" = "orderexecutions"."ordersmark"  GROUP BY "orderexecutions"."ordersmark", "orders"."dealedge"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of filled quantity per orders within orders.dealedge
gap to the g average of average of filled quantity (g level)
rank within the group by average of filled quantity, keep the top 3

rank within the group by average of total rebate: gap to the all average, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "orderexecutions"."ordersmark" AS e, "orders"."orderflow" AS g, AVG("orderexecutions"."remaincount") AS m1 FROM "orderexecutions" JOIN "orders" ON "orders"."recordvault" = "orderexecutions"."ordersmark"  GROUP BY "orderexecutions"."ordersmark", "orders"."orderflow"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
